newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U rises on U.S., Roche report.
newsitem.headline: P&U rises on U.S., Roche report.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn (P&U) posted gains on Tuesday morning, driven up by rises in the U.S. and good first half sales figures from Swiss Roche Holding, brokers said.
At 0950 GMT P&U shares were 6.5 crowns higher at 291.5 crowns, moving against the Stockholm general index that fell 0.44 percent.
In the U.S. the share closed at 295 crowns which 10 crowns above its close in Stockholm on Monday. The U.S. drugs sector index rose 0.65 percent.
Brokers said P&U was also boosted by Roche's increased sales.
"Roche's half year report showed that drugs sales rose by 20 percent," said one broker.
